collector_guards.cleanup: restore original live application before stopping own front child; preserve changed foreground; report failure and retain IPC for live child; final exit uses post-defer result
collector_guards.media: source-bound Ready to Paused0, error/source checks retained
collector_guards.mode: CI14 or explicit own-pid-active13; no CI impersonation
collector_guards.temporal: all entry uptimes at/after arm; last complete placement at/before stable image sample begin

fixed_findings.finding: defer cleanup could overturn success after a zero return had been chosen
live child after termination could remain successful
IPC removal while child intentionally remains live
prior valid ledger prefix could survive helper I/O failure
fixed_findings.status: fixed by bounded application.log checks before completion and after cleanup

fixed_findings.finding: PNG path contents were not bound to capture PNG digest
fixed_findings.status: fixed; actual digests checked and recorded

fixed_findings.finding: decoded ICC must match capture receipt

ledger.failure_contract: missing/truncated/incomplete data rejected; encoding/I/O failure can preserve an old prefix, so stderr marker rejection is required
math_limits: offered width need not equal extent
row length is sum(extents)+sum(gaps); finalX uses original incremental order, so independent recomputation needs floating tolerance
recorded points/proposals are Layout requested arguments, not native frames, bezels or ink
ledger.original_query_order: nonspacer sizeThatFits(0), sizeThatFits(nil), sizeThatFits(infinity), dimensions(in:), place; spacers retain original bypasses
ledger.post_place_only: arm filesystem, packet construction, encoding and write follow all original place calls and final x advance
ledger.snapshots: raw after original queries; normalized from original Item; dimensions after original values; placedX after original place and before original x advance

limits: instrumentation allocation/timing and post-place I/O may affect behavior; actual original-pixel observer control remains required
finite complete prefix does not prove settled state or app lifetime; end_state remains not_observed
placement-before-sample is not a presentation synchronization fence; a later placement may conservatively reject a run
fixed ROI equality is not whole-window equality or proof of every native Frame boundary
f9 evidence supplies collector source only; it is not an e48 product/control result

pixel_gate.comparison: all decoded active pixel bytes including stored alpha; row padding excluded; no color conversion/resampling
pixel_gate.pair: same OS 13 or 14, same canvas920x668, descriptor/ICC exact, scale1or2, control off and observer on
pixel_gate.report_binding: success/closed-only/cleanup/source/context + actual PNG SHA and decoded ICC SHA
pixel_gate.whole_window: difference retained separately; not the pass condition

scope: Read-only ledger source and final closed collector/pixel-gate guard review; no runtime or visual acceptance.

validation.reviewer: source reads, hashes and Python AST parse only; no patch/helper execution, compiler, UI, CI or fixtures
validation.root_receipt: typechecks.json binds final collector/pixel gate and extracted Row source to SDK14.2/min13 Swift5 typecheck exit0; performed by root, not this reviewer
